_doc: Single source of truth for mobile frame baseline + frame-level structural composition + page-style modes. baseline.mobile.{w,h} — DS-variable bindings (numbers-paddings). frame_gap — canvas-only literal. composition — STRUCTURAL invariants (R-0/R-1/R-2/R-3). pageStyleModes — flat / with-islands mode specs (paddings, fills, gap'ы). meshokPositioning — positioning rules for meshok ↑ / meshok ↓. Variable references inside pageStyleModes/meshokPositioning use NAMES only (string) — Builder resolves to figma-key at runtime via registry/libraries/numbers-paddings/variables.json. Literal 0 stays as numeric 0. Human-readable prose — rules/skeleton.md.

meshokPositioning._doc: Structural positioning rules for meshok ↑ and meshok ↓. Apply in both page style modes. meshok ↓ ALWAYS absolute — overlay'ит над content_body, не отнимает у него vertical space, поэтому content_body имеет paddingBottom = content-to-bottom. meshok ↑ по умолчанию в auto-layout flow (первый ребёнок контейнера), исключение — scroll-state demo переключает на absolute pinned top.

pageStyleModes._doc: Two mutually exclusive page-style modes. Builder picks the mode BEFORE composing content_body: by default asks the designer 'flat or with-islands?'; exception — when every screen has ≤1 meaningful content block (typical sign-up / linear onboarding), auto-picks flat and tells the designer in one line. Exact rule lives in .claude/commands/builder.md → Page style modes. Variable references are by NAME (string). Builder resolves name → figma-key via registry/libraries/numbers-paddings/variables.json on runtime. Numeric 0 means literal zero (no variable binding).

firstIsland._doc: Первый остров на странице — встраивает meshok ↑ как первого ребёнка, сливается с верхом экрана. Top corners НЕ скруглены. Контент острова под meshok'ом сидит во внутреннем wrapper-фрейме с cp-16 паддингом.

subsequentIslands._doc: Остров 2..N — стандартные. Все 4 угла скруглены, одинаковые паддинги со всех сторон.
